key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Acute, over hours. LOCATION: Headache (occipital or diffuse), chest (if cardiac involvement), generalized symptoms. DURATION: Continuous. CHARACTER: Severe headache, dyspnea, chest pain, vision changes, confusion. AGGRAVATING: Medication non-compliance, stress. RELIEVING: Blood pressure reduction. TIMING: Progressive. SEVERITY: 8-10/10 for headache or symptoms. KEY POSITIVES: Severe hypertension (BP >180/120), end-organ damage (altered mental status, chest pain, dyspnea, vision changes, seizures), headache, nausea, vomiting. KEY NEGATIVES: NOT isolated elevated BP without symptoms (that's hypertensive urgency).
